Vehicles pulled by animals.

9 Hard shoulders
 
Exceptionally, when the hard shoulder is deemed useable and of sufficient width, mopeds may also travel side by side. However they must never invade the roadway.
All vehicles that travel on the hard shoulder, with the exception of cycles, must not travel side by side for more than 15 seconds or more than 200 metres when carrying out an overtake.

answers.text:
Los vehículos con MMA no superior a 3.500 kg que circulen a velocidad anormalmente reducida.

Cycles, mopeds and vehicles for persons with reduced mobility.

questions.help:
9 Hard shoulders  
 
On some roadways there is an area that runs parallel to the main carriageway, this is called the ‘hard shoulder.’
The following must travel on the hard shoulder, on the right going with the traffic flow, (unless there is a road or part of it specifically designated for their use:
Vehicles pulled by animals.
Special vehicles with a MAM not exceeding 3,500 kg’.
Cycles.
Vehicles following cyclists.
Mopeds.
Vehicles for people with reduced mobility.
However the hard shoulder must be useable. When the road does not have a hard shoulder or it is not useable or sufficient, for instance it is not wide enough, these users must travel as close as possible to the right edge of the roadway, occupying as little as possible of the roadway.
(Página 168 del manual 'Learning to drive')
